name: Ninjago: Prime Empire RPG
author: MattadorStarfish
description:
Explore the world of Prime Empire in the brand new game from Milton Dyer! After his previous game  gained sentience and caused havoc in Ninjago City, Milton wanted to make a new game to apologise for the chaos. He was also so inspired by the heroics of the Ninja, that he made them the stars of the new game. 

Hold spacebar to press buttons and press spacebar for everything else.
